description: This Java class defines a database migration for an Android application, specifically migrating database schema from version 14 to 15. It renames a temporary notes table, creates new tables for notes and categories, and migrates data from the old table to the new structure, including category normalization.

classes.name: Migration_14_15
classes.description: A class extending Room's Migration to handle schema changes from version 14 to 15, including data migration and table restructuring.

methods.name: Migration_14_15
methods.description: Constructor initializing migration from version 14 to 15.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs the database migration: renaming tables, creating new tables, migrating data, and cleaning up temporary tables.
